title: No. 9, accounts
text:
Line, tarred: 4 Crowns. Paid.
Lead, 14 lb: borrowed. O.B. not to know.
Coal: owed.
Bread: owed.
Rent, the quarter: 15 Crowns. Owed.
The Counting-House sends a runner every Friday, who apologises. Paid the runner in toffee.
Rent: still owed.
The line comes first. The next Tinker can have the rent.
